messages.subject: Predict error
parts:
Hi I am trying to use the predict function on a distsamp model. I
have a new data frame with the covariates I want to use to predict
with and they are named the same as covariates in the model. This is
the error I get.


EB <- predict(brcrELAMD, type='state', newdata = PBRCR,
appendData=TRUE)
Warning: 'newdata' had 5698 rows but variable(s) found have 662 rows
Error in data.frame(out, as(newdata, "data.frame")) :
arguments imply differing number of rows: 662, 5698

Here are the first couple of rows from the data frame passed to
newdata

OBJECTID COV_BH.Z.AMD_PC
COV_BH.Z.ELEVATION
1
-0.75874679 0.6978279
2
-0.55579627 0.6281503

Here is my model:

> summary(brcrELAMD)

Call:
distsamp(formula = ~1 ~ COV_BH$Z.ELEVATION + COV_BH$Z.AMD_PC,
data = brcrptUMFv1, keyfun = "halfnorm", output = "density",
unitsOut = "kmsq", rel.tol = 0.01)

Density (log-scale):
Estimate SE z P(>|z|)
(Intercept) 1.496 0.380 3.94 8.28e-05
COV_BH$Z.ELEVATION 1.082 0.471 2.30 2.17e-02
COV_BH$Z.AMD_PC 0.509 0.207 2.46 1.39e-02

Detection (log-scale):
Estimate SE z P(>|z|)
3.39 0.113 29.9 5.24e-196

AIC: 318.5152
Number of sites: 662
optim convergence code: 0
optim iterations: 36
Bootstrap iterations: 0

Survey design: point-transect
Detection function: halfnorm
UnitsIn: m
UnitsOut: kmsq

Any help would be appreciated

Rob
